retrieval.rag_summary:
Trade Select EasySeal Insulation Flashing Tape represents a
heavy-duty, weather-resistant flashing tape designed to provide watertight and
airtight seals around window openings, door frames, and building envelope
penetrations. Coated with an aggressive pressure-sensitive adhesive on a
flexible carrier, it bonds tightly to building wraps, timber, steel, and masonry
to prevent water ingress and draughts in accordance with AS/NZS 4200.2
weatherproofing guidelines.
